annotations.title: UK student loan repayments and write-off

description: What a UK student loan costs a month now, and whether it's cleared or written off first: a month-by-month projection to the plan's write-off on stated assumptions (pay rises and RPI, which the caller may change), with this year's threshold and interest rate, the total repaid and the sources. A projection, not a forecast, and information, not financial advice: it never says whether to pay a loan off early.

extra_monthly.description: Paid on top each month, in pounds

first_due_year.description: The year of the April repayments were first due: the April after leaving the course

plan.description: plan1 (England or Wales before September 2012, and Northern Ireland), plan2 (England from September 2012 to July 2023, and Wales from September 2012), plan4 (Scotland), plan5 (England from August 2023), postgrad (master's or doctoral loans in England or Wales)

rpi_percent.description: Assumed RPI a year, after this year's published rates

salary.description: Pay before tax for a year, in pounds
